text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to limit sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly. Even a short walk every day can make a big difference. Third, get enough sleep—about seven to eight hours for most adults. Good sleep helps you think clearly and feel happier. Don't forget mental health. Talk to friends, relax, and take breaks when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a healthy work-life balance. Spend time on hobbies and with family. Small daily habits lead to a healthier, happier life.
